recipes.name: Let's Make: French Onion Soup
ingredients: For the Bone Marrow and Toasts
4 –6 marrow bones, cut lengthwise or crosswise
1 baguette, sliced into 2 cm pieces (about 4 per serving)
reserved rendered marrow fat (or substitute with butter/oil)
6 cups beef stock or bone broth
1 leek green or cheesecloth for wrapping
instructions: For the Bone Marrow Prep
Brine the bones: Soak marrow bones in salted water overnight (if frozen, this also helps thaw them). - 4 –6 marrow bones cut lengthwise or crosswise - cold water & salt (for brining)
Roast: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Place bones cut side up on a foil "cradle" to prevent tipping. Roast for ~20–25 minutes until marrow is puffed and fat is rendered.
Separate fat and marrow: Cool slightly. Scoop out marrow and reserve. Strain and reserve rendered fat for toasts.
For the Baguette
Slice baguette into 2 cm rounds. Cut some pieces in half if needed to fit soup crocks. - 1 baguette sliced into 2 cm pieces (about 4 per serving)
Brush both sides with marrow fat. Sprinkle with salt. - reserved rendered marrow fat (or substitute with butter/oil) - salt to taste
Toast in a 400°F oven (preferably convection) on a wire rack until golden brown and crispy, flipping if needed.
For the Onions
In a large nonstick or heavy-bottomed sauté pan, melt 2 tbsp butter over medium heat. - 2 tbsp unsalted butter divided
Add sliced onions and a splash (~½ cup) of water. Cover and cook over medium-low heat until softened (~5–10 min). - 8 large yellow onions thinly sliced
Remove lid, stir frequently, and cook down for 45–60 minutes, adding water as needed to prevent burning. You want them soft, sweet, and deeply golden.
For the Soup
Transfer onions to a soup pot with 1–2 tbsp butter. - 1 tbsp unsalted butter divided
Add 1–2 tbsp flour and cook, stirring, for 1–2 minutes to lightly brown and cook off raw flour taste. - 1–2 tbsp all purpose flour
Stir in tomato paste (if using). - –2 tsp tomato paste (optional)
Deglaze with brandy, scraping up fond. - 2 tbsp –3 tbsp brandy
Add stock in stages, stirring well to incorporate flour. - 6 cups beef stock or bone broth
Add soy sauce, Worcestershire, and fish sauce. Simmer for 30 minutes. - 1 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce (or to taste) - 1 tsp fish sauce (optional)
For the Bouquet Garni
Tie herbs in leek greens or cheesecloth. - 2 –3 sprigs thyme - 2 –3 sprigs parsley - 1 bay leaf - leek green or cheesecloth for wrapping
Add to soup and simmer during the last 15–20 minutes. Remove before serving.
For the Assembly and Broiling
Preheat broiler.
Spread whipped bone marrow on toasts, then grate raw garlic over each one. - bone marrow (whipped into a paste) - 1 garlic clove
Ladle hot soup into oven-safe crocks, place toasts on top, and generously top with grated Gruyère. - 1 1/2–2 cups grated Gruyère cheese
Broil until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and golden brown (2–5 minutes depending on your broiler).
For the Finishing
Garnish with chopped chives. - Optional: finely chopped fresh chives
Enjoy with temperature-aware caution
